summary: Phase 12e Milestone Celebrations — backend + frontend E2E verified. All 9 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_milestones.py pass (run sequentially with delay to avoid /auth/login rate-limit cascade). Seeded UI Pro user (mileui@example.com / Mile9!Mile9!) surfaces all 6 milestone keys via GET /api/hb/milestones with exact-spec titles + messages. Frontend celebration overlay auto-mounts on Dashboard, cycles all 6 milestones on Continue click, unmounts after last, and does not re-appear after reload. My Milestones card renders on Account with all 6 rows, correct check icons, formatted dates. Copy in every card matches spec verbatim.

minor.issue: Existing 8-req/IP/5min rate limit makes the milestones pytest suite (9 logins) fail with 429s when run in parallel (pytest-xdist default). Ran sequentially with 45s delay per test — all pass. Recommend adding a small login helper cache or bumping the rate limit in test envs to make CI reliable.

issues: Rows are ordered by achieved_at ISO ascending as spec requires, but when several milestones fall on the SAME calendar date (e.g. streak_7 and streak_30 both awarded today) streak_30 is displayed before streak_7 because it happens to be inserted first. Semantically minor / cosmetic — a secondary sort by milestone 'rank' or key would read more naturally.

action_items: (Optional) Sort inline My Milestones card by (achieved_at, milestone rank) so streak_7 precedes streak_30 when they share a date.
(Optional) Consider whitelisting or raising the /auth/login rate limit in dev/test — the milestones suite triggers 429s under parallel execution.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint pair implements idempotent unique index (user_id, key) — good.
MilestoneCelebration overlay uses z-index 85 which sits above ai-agent-sheet as designed; Continue button is directly clickable through the sheet.
MyMilestones component silently swallows API errors on load and celebrate — acceptable for this UX but a subtle debug log would help field diagnosis.
